name: Outpost
description: A free, daily intelligence briefing on cybersecurity, modern warfare and geopolitics — compiled from the open web.

adsense._note: Create ad units in AdSense and paste each unit's numeric slot id below. A blank slot renders nothing (no empty boxes, no layout shift). Auto ads work independently if enabled in the AdSense console.

verification._note: Optional. A non-empty value makes the page head emit the matching meta tag (google: google-site-verification, bing: msvalidate.01). Paste only the token from the content attribute, not the whole tag. Not needed if you verify Search Console by DNS TXT.

promo.name: Cylist
promo.label: Threat intelligence triage for SOC analysts
promo.text: Paste an IP, domain, URL or file hash and get an AI-generated verdict and a case report — built for the analyst who reads the briefing and then has to act on it.
